title: A batch gate whose test file hangs reaches an outcome without a loop restart
description: Runs the loop's real gate step over a test install whose rerun of a failing test file never ends, while a merge trial holds every ordinary host slot: the rerun stops at the five-minute per-file timeout, frees its slot, the probe on the verified commit starts on that slot, and the gate verifies with the file a known red (GY-3800).

steps.name: a hanging test file stops at the per-file timeout and the gate reaches an outcome
